summary: Frontend-only test of the Return trip checkbox and the return-trip Quick Draft Plan, on test-user-pro / Model Vessel at 390x844. All 6 requested flows PASS. One real data bug: the Leg 2 that Quick Draft Plan creates gets today+2 days 06:00-09:00, so it can sit before Leg 1. (1) Checkbox: return-trip sits right of START/DEST (x 324-374, scrollWidth 390, no overflow) and its label reads 'RETURN / TRIP'. It is disabled and unchecked when empty or START-only, then enabled and checked once both are typed. Unticking saved weather.return_trip=false, which survived a reload, and re-ticking works. (2) Ticked, typed TEST_Mana Marina/TEST_Mana Island, no legs: quick-plan-btn shows no replace warning and opens the dialog straight away, titled 'Quick Draft Plan', with the hint 'Return trip: tap START, TEST_Mana Marina (green).' Popup 1 is prefilled with TEST_Mana Marina. Hint 2 is correct. Popup 2 has only 'DESTINATION, then return to start' plus Ignore, with no end-btn. Pins: 1 green, 2 navy, 3 red at the same pixel as 1. Done ('Done, update Route Planning') enabled after about 9s. After Done: START/DEST and Dec 18 09:00-12:00 times are kept, event_name stays TEST_Event, Leg 2 runs TEST_Mana Island->TEST_Mana Marina as Returning to Dock (dock), and the button reads 'Edit Draft Plan...'. (3) The checkbox is checked and disabled, with the title 'Leg 2 comes back to START...'. Dragging the START/end spot moved pins 1 and 3 together. Renaming point 1 (DEPARTING POINT popup) to TEST_Mana Home renamed Leg 1's START and Leg 2's DEST, and both persisted. (4) Edit Draft Plan > pin 3 > Delete > Done left 0 planned rows, unticked and enabled, which held after a reload (DB return_trip false). With no draft, edit Leg 2 > Delete Leg did the same. (5) With no draft and ticked, Add Leg... is enabled. A hand Leg 2 home stays checked and disabled. A hand Leg 2 elsewhere is unchecked and disabled. Editing its DEST to START re-checks it. A 3rd leg makes it unchecked and disabled, and Quick Draft Plan then shows the normal replace warning. Deleting Leg 3 brought back checked and disabled. Quick Draft Plan with a hand-made 2-leg return trip skips the warning and seeds the taps, and Done kept the hand Leg 2's times and type (18/12 12:00-19/12 17:00, Mooring). (6) Unticked: the replace warning shows, then the normal flow ('Tap where you'll depart from.'), and popup 2 has 'Arriving (Leg 2 Departing point)' and 'Arriving (End of Trip point)'.

ui_bugs.issue: A new Leg 2 made by the return-trip Quick Draft Plan takes newLeg(2) times, i.e. today+2 days 06:00-09:00, and ignores Leg 1's times. With typed Leg 1 at 2026-12-18 09:00-12:00, Leg 2 was saved as 2026-11-20 06:00-09:00, departing a month BEFORE Leg 1. Fix: when there's no seed.back, set depart_at to ls[0].finish_at and finish_at to later(ls[0].finish_at, 3), or similar.

Red pin 3 sits exactly on top of green pin 1, which has a lower z-index, so the green START is never visible or tappable. Dragging moves both, so it works, but the user can't see the green START and tapping the spot always opens 'Point 3 (End of Trip)'. Consider offsetting pin 3 slightly or drawing a combined green/red marker.

issues: When checked and disabled (a 2-leg return trip), the native checkbox renders very pale grey/green on the mint background, so it is hard to tell it is ticked. Consider a custom styled check or a 'locked' note.
After both taps, a 'Start New Draft' button appears (fresh=false for seed) even though the title is still 'Quick Draft Plan'. Minor, but it is a bit inconsistent.

action_items: QuickPlanDialog.confirm(): give the auto-created return Leg 2 times based on Leg 1's finish (not today+2 days) when seed.back is null
Optional: make the green START visible under the red end pin on return trips; improve the look of the checked+disabled checkbox
critical_code_review_comments: QuickPlanDialog confirm(): `times` (at(i+1)) is computed for i=1 but never used for the home leg, and newLeg(2) dates come from today, so they don't follow Leg 1.
PlannedLegs remove(): the Undo toast restores legs but not return_trip. It works anyway, because isReturn re-derives ret, but weather.return_trip stays false.
NavigatorAsk: the return_trip flag is left true in the DB when a 3rd leg is added (ret is computed from the legs, so it's harmless).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (6/6 flows pass; 1 data bug in auto Leg 2 times)
